card.title: Today, and logging an action
card.sub: The daily loop: see what is due, do it, log it, and set the next step.
card.foot: Demo mode: every company, person and email here is made up, and nothing is saved.

scenes.caption: Start every day on Today. It lists what to do now, each with its action.
First, overdue. Example Ventures asked questions on our proposal, due on 21 November. The card names Rui Kowalski, and where we met: our website.
Say we have answered them by email. Press Log the follow-up on its card.
The company's page opens on Log an action: what, which way, when, who, and one line on what happened.
Here: an email, we reached out, on 23 November, to Diogo Quinn, answering their questions.
Show what will be written shows the exact file first. In the demo it stays in this tab: nothing is written anywhere.
Press Write it. The action is now first in the company's Activity. In a real vault, it is one change you can see in its history.
Now the next step. Edit stage, owner and next step keeps the lead row up to date.
The next step becomes: wait for their decision, due 30 November.
Show what will be written, then Write it. The company now shows the new next step.
Back on Today, Example Ventures is no longer overdue. Do this for each card, every day.
